name: Dragon Spiral
evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ185 as the maintained acquisition endpoint. The technique begins with an opening that blocks Ki blasts and transitions into a close-range follow-up; current repository evidence intentionally retains the explicit PQ185 route rather than resurrecting an older alternate PQ186 reference. Exact resource behavior, guard duration, hit count, and damage scaling remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Unsupported exact frames, scaling formulas, probabilities, hidden conditions, and patch-independent balance values were not inferred.
Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
